title: Pop the balloon
description: A red balloon rests on the floor at (50, 30), bottom left, and rises from the start at up to 1.5 m/s. A pin points down from (320, 290), near the top right. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 60 to 260. Left alone, the balloon drifts straight up past the pin and out of the world.
